_what: Words of the door grant screen (door-grant-screen.tsx, door-grant.mjs): the owner keeps, lists and stops a grant that lets people or AIs run some of their tools on one of their own computers. A `{name}` in a text is filled from the values the screen has; nothing here names a product, a tool or a person. Refusals are keyed by the engine's refusal code (`refused.code`), never by its message.
